events.content:
Consistent result on retry, so I'll report what the tool actually returned rather than speculate about the truncated tail.

**What I attempted:** an evidence panel covering all four layers applicable to IMP01 (discordant_pairs, soft_clipped_reads, split_reads, read_depth) around chr20:200000, using these windows:

| Layer | Region |
|---|---|
| discordant_pairs | chr20:198,500–201,500 (±1500bp) |
| soft_clipped_reads | chr20:199,850–200,150 (±150bp) |
| split_reads | chr20:198,500–201,500 (±1500bp) |
| read_depth | chr20:197,000–203,000 (±3000bp) |

**What actually happened:** image generation failed. For the two layers whose status I could confirm in the response (`discordant_pairs` and `soft_clipped_reads`), the tool explicitly returned `"error": "IGV not found"` — the underlying IGV executable (`igv.sh`) could not be located on the system in any of the searched paths. The response was truncated before reporting the status of the `split_reads` and `read_depth` panels, so I cannot confirm whether those succeeded or failed — I retried the call and got an identical truncated result, so I don't have that information.

**Bottom line:** No usable images were produced for this locus. At minimum the discordant-pairs and soft-clip panels definitively failed due to a missing IGV installation, and I have no confirmation the other two panels rendered either. I have nothing to report about visual content — per the tool's own design I would never receive pixel data even on success, only an opaque reference, and here even that reference is undermined by explicit tool errors.

Also worth flagging: this position (chr20:200000) was supplied directly by you and is not tied to any registered candidate set, so nothing here corroborates it as a genuine SV breakpoint — it's just the coordinate I was asked to inspect.

If you'd like, I can instead pull the underlying numeric evidence (discordant pair counts, soft-clip pileup, split reads, depth ratio) for this locus via the non-image tools, which don't depend on IGV being installed.
